strings.text:
An Ultimate Level Digimon that Warp
Evolved from Gabumon. Garurumon's
final form, it retains its agility
despite being covered in metal. It
crushes foes with countless hidden
weapons. It extends its beam-shaped
wings to fly through Net Space at
high speeds. Its Special Move,
Cocytus Breath, freezes its
enemies, then blows them to pieces.

The original hard-shelled Insect
Digimon, it's not very aggressive.
Each foreleg has one claw, and each
middle and hind leg has four. It
grabs objects with its middle legs.
Tentomon leads a carefree life
sniffing flowers and napping under
trees. Its Special Move, Petit
Thunder, releases static electricity
it amplifies with its wings.

An Ultimate Level Insect Digimon
with a giant horn and scissors,
that evolves with a combination of
Kabuterimon and Kuwagamon's data.
Its body shines with gold and it
flies around the Digital World at
supersonic speed. Its Special Move
is the improved version of Mega
Blaster, Giga Blaster, which
annihilates any foe.

An Angel Digimon with six shining
wings, clad in pure white holy
clothes. A being of virtue which
brings happiness but ruthlessly
fights evil until it's vanquished.
Legends say that, when the Digital
World's in danger, it descends to
lead Digimon of the same genus. Its
Special Move, Heaven's Knuckle,
smashes enemies with a shining
golden fist.

An Ophan Digimon, the final form of
the female Angel Digimon. One of the
Three Archangel Digimon that protect
the Digital World's core "Kernel"
(God's domain). The Digital World's
Holy Mother that brings God's
compassion and love, while
Seraphimon executes God's will
and Cherubimon guards the divine
wisdom. Its Special Move is Eden's
Javelin.

It grows by absorbing more and more
data in the internet, almost
destroying the electronic world.
Convinced of its own omniscience and
omnipotence, it began to enjoy
rampaging. Its goal is to use
military computers to destroy the
Real World with nuclear weapons. Its
Special Move, Catastrophe Cannon,
shoots powerful destructive energy
from its chest-cannon.

OmegaShoutmon was the form achieved
when Omegamon bestowed the Legendary
Evolution upon Shoutmon, unleashing
its burning spirit. Its body's
enveloped in this newfound power,
the Omega inForce, which gave it a
golden shine and a sharp, crisp 
build. Its Special Move, Heavy
Metal Vulcan, fires shots
transformed into heat by its chest's
blazing friendship.
